# Faraway

Faraway is a macOS menu bar app that helps people working long screen sessions reduce eye strain.
Primary use case: reminder-based eye breaks based on the 20-20-20 rule.

Status: Product site is available at https://mayaway.cc/ with releases published via GitHub.

## What makes it useful
- Faraway sends local reminders every 20 minutes (default), with optional full-screen countdowns for a 20-second break.
- The app runs on macOS and can use app-aware scheduling for work sessions.
- Data remains local by design; no cloud analytics collection is described in the product messaging.

## Product facts
- Platform: macOS 13+
- Application type: Health and productivity menu bar utility
- Data handling: local-first, no analytics/telemetry claims published in product description
- Data model statement: Faraway is described as a local macOS reminder utility and does not claim usage telemetry.
